True item parameters and simulation scenarios of the sleep example

true_items.Rd

`true_items`: the seven PSQI-component GRM items of the simulated sleep example (slopes a, thresholds b, intercepts d = -a b). `scenarios`: the six data-generating models of the simulation study, each a list(label, m = true mean curve, sd = true residual SD function, ld = local dependence). They are truths only; no analysis model assumes their shape.

Usage

true_items

scenarios

Format

lists
